This is the chronological index of Star Wars CCG tournaments this wiki has sourced. The history of Swiss, ratings, and decklist sheets is on [[Tournaments]]. Every World Championship, with champions, sites and winning decks: [[World Championships]]. European Championship years are on [[European Championships]].

The Players Committee posts results newest-first at [https://www.starwarsccg.org/tournaments/ starwarsccg.org/tournaments] and [https://www.starwarsccg.org/category/tournament-decklists/ Tournament Decklists]. This table follows that desk: '''newest first''' within a year, then earlier years. Years 1996–2001 are on their own pages (see [[#1996–2001 (Decipher era)|below]]). The Event name is a wiki link when this wiki has a hub for that tournament. '''Format''' is the constructed pool named for that event.
